title: A Path a Car Can Drive: Searching Over Pose and Heading With Arcs the Car Can Make, and Why the Grid Path With Its Corners Is Not a Path at All

artifact.note: hybrid A*: a search over (x, y, heading) in which each step is an arc of a car with the steering at one of a few angles, the result is a path whose every part is an arc the car can drive, nodes are kept one to a cell of a coarse grid of position and heading, the cost is the length with penalties for steering, changing steering and reversing, and the heuristic is the distance to the goal
